## The best-maintained rentals on the market.

We don't list homes we wouldn't live in. Every property is inspected, cleaned, and turned by our in-house maintenance team before move-in — then supported the same way after.

Every home is checked before a single photo goes online. If it can't pass, it isn't listed.

Common Questions

## Working With Our Agents

Do I need to pay an agent fee to use your services?

No. Our services are free for renters and buyers. We are compensated through a standard co-brokerage arrangement with the listing owner — you pay nothing out of pocket for working with our team.

Can I work with a specific agent I've spoken with before?

Absolutely. If you have an existing relationship with one of our specialists, just reference their name when you contact us and we'll make sure they handle your inquiry.

What areas do your agents cover?

Our main office is in Clearfield, VA with active coverage across Hampton Roads. We also help clients relocating to Atlanta, Charlotte, Houston, Dallas, Nashville, Phoenix, and other major markets through our partner network.

How quickly can an agent respond to my inquiry?

Our standard is within 24 hours on business days — usually much faster. For urgent moves or expiring application deadlines, call us directly and we'll prioritize your case.

Can your agents help with both renting and buying?

Yes. Most of our specialists handle both rental and purchase transactions. If you're undecided between renting and buying, your agent can walk you through the financial comparison for your specific situation.

# Privacy Policy

Last updated: January 1, 2025

## 1\. Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us when you submit an inquiry, rental application, or contact form. This includes your name, email address, phone number, and any details about your housing needs.

## 2\. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

*   Match you with available rental and for-sale properties
*   Respond to your inquiries and schedule viewings
*   Process rental applications
*   Send you updates about properties that match your criteria
*   Improve our services

## 3\. Information Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent, except as necessary to process your application or as required by law.

## 4\. Data Security

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

## 5\. Cookies

Our website may use cookies to enhance your browsing experience. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings.

## 6\. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us at [info@primefamilyhousing.com](mailto:info@primefamilyhousing.com).

## 7\. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:  
PrimeFamilyHousing  
1230 Peachtree Street NE, Suite 400, Atlanta, GA 30309  
[info@primefamilyhousing.com](mailto:info@primefamilyhousing.com)

# Terms of Service

Last updated: January 1, 2025

## 1\. Acceptance of Terms

Our services are intended to help individuals find affordable rental and for-sale properties. You agree to use our services only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms.

## 3\. Property Listings

## 4\. Application Process

Atlanta is one of the most affordable major cities in the US for renters. With a thriving job market anchored by Fortune 500 headquarters, world-class dining, and neighborhoods ranging from the historic charm of Grant Park to the modern energy of Midtown, Atlanta offers something for every budget.

PrimeFamilyHousing maintains a curated inventory of affordable rental homes and apartments across Atlanta's most desirable neighborhoods — including Buckhead, East Atlanta Village, Decatur, Sandy Springs, and Marietta. Our listings start from around $950/month for one-bedroom apartments, with family-sized homes available from $1,400/month.

Atlanta's cost of living is approximately 5% below the national average, making it an ideal destination for families, young professionals, and anyone relocating to the Southeast. With MARTA public transit, Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport, and a rapidly expanding BeltLine trail system, Atlanta combines big-city amenities with Southern affordability.

## Renting in Atlanta — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Atlanta?

The average rent in Atlanta starts around $1,150/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Atlanta?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Atlanta?

Yes. Several of our Atlanta listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Atlanta?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

## Renting in Charlotte

$1,100

Avg. Rent

245

Homes Available

24 hrs

Decision Time

Charlotte is one of the fastest-growing cities in the United States, yet it remains one of the most affordable major metros on the East Coast. As the second-largest banking center in the US, Charlotte offers strong employment opportunities alongside a lower cost of living than comparable cities.

PrimeFamilyHousing serves the greater Charlotte area with affordable rentals in neighborhoods like South End, NoDa, Plaza Midwood, University City, and Ballantyne. Studio apartments start from around $850/month, and family homes are available from $1,300/month.

Charlotte's combination of mild climate, excellent schools, professional sports teams, and proximity to both the Blue Ridge Mountains and Atlantic beaches makes it a top relocation destination. The LYNX light rail connects key neighborhoods, and the cost of living sits about 4% below the national average.

## Renting in Charlotte — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Charlotte?

The average rent in Charlotte starts around $1,100/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Charlotte?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Charlotte?

Yes. Several of our Charlotte listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Charlotte?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

Decision Time

Houston offers one of the largest supplies of affordable rental housing among major US cities. With no state income tax, a diverse economy spanning energy, healthcare, aerospace, and technology, and a cost of living well below coastal metros, Houston is a top choice for budget-conscious renters.

PrimeFamilyHousing maintains extensive listings across Houston's sprawling metro — from the cultural richness of Montrose and the Heights to family-friendly suburbs like Katy, Sugar Land, and Pearland. One-bedroom apartments start from around $900/month, with spacious family homes from $1,350/month.

Houston's lack of zoning laws creates a unique rental market with diverse housing options at every price point. The Texas Medical Center, NASA's Johnson Space Center, and the Port of Houston drive steady employment, while the city's world-renowned food scene and 640+ parks provide quality of life that rivals cities twice the cost.

## Renting in Houston — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Houston?

The average rent in Houston starts around $1,050/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Houston?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Houston?

Yes. Several of our Houston listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Houston?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

The Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex is the fourth-largest metro area in the United States and one of the most affordable. With no state income tax, a booming technology sector, and corporate headquarters for AT&T, Southwest Airlines, and dozens of Fortune 500 companies, Dallas offers exceptional economic opportunity at a fraction of coastal city prices.

PrimeFamilyHousing serves the greater Dallas area including Uptown, Deep Ellum, Oak Lawn, Plano, Frisco, and Arlington. Apartments start from around $950/month, and family homes are available from $1,400/month across the metroplex.

Dallas combines a thriving arts and dining scene with family-friendly suburbs, excellent highway connectivity, and DART public transit. The cost of living is approximately 2% below the national average, and the rental market offers a wide range of options from modern downtown lofts to suburban single-family homes.

## Renting in Dallas — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Dallas?

The average rent in Dallas starts around $1,100/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Dallas?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Dallas?

Yes. Several of our Dallas listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Dallas?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

Nashville has experienced tremendous growth over the past decade, yet affordable rental options remain available throughout the metro — particularly in neighborhoods just outside the downtown core. With no state income tax on wages, a booming healthcare and music industry, and a vibrant cultural scene, Nashville attracts renters from across the country.

PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable rentals across Nashville including East Nashville, Germantown, Berry Hill, Antioch, and Murfreesboro. One-bedroom apartments are available from around $1,000/month, and family homes start from $1,450/month.

Nashville's economy is anchored by healthcare giants like HCA and Vanderbilt, a thriving music and entertainment industry, and a rapidly growing tech sector. The city's walkable neighborhoods, excellent food scene, and strong sense of community make it an increasingly popular choice for families and young professionals seeking affordable Southern living.

## Renting in Nashville — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Nashville?

The average rent in Nashville starts around $1,200/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Nashville?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Nashville?

Yes. Several of our Nashville listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Nashville?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

Phoenix is the fifth-largest city in the United States and one of the most affordable major metros in the Sun Belt. With over 300 days of sunshine per year, a growing technology and healthcare sector, and rental prices significantly below California and Pacific Northwest competitors, Phoenix is ideal for budget-conscious renters seeking warm-weather living.

PrimeFamilyHousing serves the greater Phoenix metro including Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Gilbert, and Glendale. Apartments start from around $950/month, with family homes available from $1,400/month across the Valley.

Phoenix's cost of living is approximately 3% below the national average, with particular savings in housing. The metro's extensive freeway system, growing light rail network, and proximity to outdoor recreation — from Camelback Mountain to Sedona day trips — provide a quality of life that makes Phoenix one of the fastest-growing cities in America.

## Renting in Phoenix — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Phoenix?

The average rent in Phoenix starts around $1,100/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Phoenix?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Phoenix?

Yes. Several of our Phoenix listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Phoenix?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

## Renting in Austin

Decision Time

Austin is a top-tier technology hub with a cost of living that remains well below Silicon Valley, Seattle, or New York. While central Austin has seen price increases, affordable rental options are abundant in surrounding areas — and PrimeFamilyHousing specializes in finding them.

Our Austin-area listings span neighborhoods like East Austin, Mueller, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Cedar Park, and Kyle. One-bedroom apartments start from around $1,050/month, and family homes are available from $1,500/month.

Austin's economy is powered by major employers including Tesla, Apple, Google, Dell, and the University of Texas. Combined with no state income tax, a world-famous live music scene, excellent outdoor recreation along Lady Bird Lake and the Barton Creek Greenbelt, and consistently mild winters, Austin offers an exceptional quality-to-cost ratio for renters willing to explore beyond the downtown core.

## Renting in Austin — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Austin?

The average rent in Austin starts around $1,250/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Austin?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Austin?

Yes. Several of our Austin listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Austin?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

## Renting in Miami

Miami is known for its beaches, international culture, and vibrant nightlife — but it also has pockets of genuinely affordable housing throughout the greater metro area. With no state income tax, a growing tech and finance sector, and year-round tropical weather, Miami attracts renters from across the globe.

PrimeFamilyHousing focuses on affordable Miami-area rentals in neighborhoods like Little Havana, Hialeah, Kendall, Homestead, North Miami, and Doral. One-bedroom apartments start from around $1,100/month, and family homes are available from $1,600/month.

While South Beach and Brickell command premium prices, the greater Miami metro offers a wide range of budget-friendly options with easy access to the beach, diverse cuisine, and a thriving cultural scene. Miami's Metrorail and Metrobus systems connect affordable neighborhoods to employment centers, making it possible to enjoy Miami living without Miami Beach prices.

## Renting in Miami — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Miami?

The average rent in Miami starts around $1,350/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Miami?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Miami?

Yes. Several of our Miami listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Miami?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

How do I apply for a rental in Las Vegas?

Yes. Several of our Las Vegas listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Las Vegas?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

## Renting in Jacksonville — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Jacksonville?

The average rent in Jacksonville starts around $1,743/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Jacksonville?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Jacksonville?

Yes. Several of our Jacksonville listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Jacksonville?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

## Renting in Orlando — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Orlando?

The average rent in Orlando starts around $2,047/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Orlando?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Orlando?

Yes. Several of our Orlando listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Orlando?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

## Renting in Aurora — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Aurora?

The average rent in Aurora starts around $2,220/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Aurora?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Aurora?

Yes. Several of our Aurora listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Aurora?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

## Renting in Fort Worth — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Fort Worth?

The average rent in Fort Worth starts around $1,826/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Fort Worth?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Fort Worth?

Yes. Several of our Fort Worth listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Fort Worth?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

How much does it cost to rent a home in Mesa?

The average rent in Mesa starts around $1,779/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Mesa?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Mesa?

Yes. Several of our Mesa listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Mesa?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

## Renting in Dallas — FAQ

How much does it cost to rent a home in Dallas?

The average rent in Dallas starts around $1,595/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Dallas?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Dallas?

Yes. Several of our Dallas listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Dallas?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

How much does it cost to rent a home in Bradenton?

How do I apply for a rental in Bradenton?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Bradenton?

Yes. Several of our Bradenton listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Bradenton?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

How much does it cost to rent a home in Raleigh?

How do I apply for a rental in Raleigh?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Raleigh?

Yes. Several of our Raleigh listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Raleigh?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

The average rent in Chandler starts around $1,906/month. PrimeFamilyHousing offers affordable, move-in ready rentals with transparent pricing on every listing.

How do I apply for a rental in Chandler?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Chandler?

Yes. Several of our Chandler listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Chandler?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

How do I apply for a rental in Durham?

Apply online at primefamilyhousing.com/apply in under 10 minutes. We review every application within 24 hours. No paper forms, no runaround.

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Durham?

Yes. Several of our Durham listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Durham?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.

How do I apply for a rental in Garner?

Does PrimeFamilyHousing have pet-friendly rentals in Garner?

Yes. Several of our Garner listings are pet-friendly. Pet policies are disclosed upfront on every listing so you never waste time on a home that won't accept your pet.

Are there any hidden fees when renting through PrimeFamilyHousing in Garner?

No. The price listed is the price you pay. Standard upfront costs are a security deposit (typically 1–2 months rent) and the first month's rent. All fees are shown before you apply.
